statements: IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Communication', N'U') IS NULL CREATE TABLE dbo.Communication  (id INT IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, comm_action NVARCHAR(255), comm_channelid INT, payload NVARCHAR(450))
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name = N'idx_comm_action' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Communication')) CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX idx_comm_action ON dbo.Communication (comm_action)

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes WHERE name = N'idx_comm_channelid' AND object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Communication')) CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX idx_comm_channelid ON dbo.Communication (comm_channelid)

INSERT INTO Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) SELECT 'Action' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS NVARCHAR), ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID()) % 100), REPLICATE('A', 100) FROM master.dbo.spt_values WHERE type = 'P' AND number <= 1000000
